content.tagline: Chinese manufacturer of aerial work platforms and vacuum lifting equipment
content.descriptor: Jinan PLK Machinery: spider cranes, boom lifts, scissor lifts and vacuum lifters for construction, glazing, warehouses and industrial maintenance
about: According to its official website, Jinan PLK Machinery Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 in Jinan, Shandong Province, and has grown into a manufacturer of aerial work platforms, lifting machines and material lifts. The company says it designs and builds its equipment itself, with its own R&D, production, quality control and export sales.

The company names spider cranes, compact track-mounted mini cranes with remote control, as its signature line. It also makes articulated and telescopic boom lifts, scissor lifts and vacuum lifters for glass, sheet metal, stone slabs and plastic panels.

PLK states that it employs more than 500 people, including its own engineering team, and that its equipment is used in construction, industrial maintenance, warehouse logistics, glass installation and infrastructure projects. These are the company’s own figures; Teranova has not verified them independently.
facts: Founded in 2003 in Jinan, Shandong (company data)
Boom lifts with working heights of 14–52 m
channels: Warehouses, logistics companies and industrial plants

lines.name: Spider cranes
lines.note: Compact track-mounted mini cranes with remote control and a lifting capacity of 1 to 8 t, according to the company. Built to pass through standard doorways and to work on sensitive floors.

lines.name: Boom lifts
lines.note: Articulated and telescopic boom lifts with working heights from 14 to 52 m, according to the company. Articulated booms reach up and over obstacles.

lines.name: Scissor lifts
lines.note: Mobile and self-propelled scissor lifts with platforms up to 2.5 × 1.5 m and roll-out extensions, according to the company. Electric drive for quiet work indoors.

lines.name: Vacuum lifters
lines.note: Lifters for glass, sheet metal, stone slabs and plastic panels: up to 500 kg for single-panel units and 2,000 kg and more for modular systems, according to the company.

lines.name: Other lifting and handling equipment
lines.note: The company’s catalogue also lists lift tables, floor cranes, order pickers, cargo lifts, loading docks, and stair and wheelchair lifts.

tech.name: Custom builds (OEM/ODM)
tech.note: The company offers OEM and ODM work: logo, packaging, colours and materials, as well as changes for a specific site, such as platform extensions or the position of the control panel.

tech.name: Engineering and quality control
tech.note: PLK describes 3D modelling and finite element analysis at the design stage, and quality checks at five points, from incoming raw materials to the final operational test.

tech.name: Redundant vacuum circuits
tech.note: According to the company, its vacuum systems have redundant circuits: if one fails, the backup takes over and the load is not dropped.
